verdict.rationale: Vestd offers shareholder communications features (segmented mailing lists, regular updates 'directly from the Vestd platform') and a digital cap table as single source of truth, which reduces founder-investor email back-and-forth. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm a dedicated investor-facing 'portal' where investors log in to self-serve view their holdings, nor structured automated update workflows specific to investors vs. general stakeholders. Missing for 10: explicit investor self-service portal/login evidence, confirmation investors can view real-time holdings themselves, and detail on structured/automated update cadence or templates.
